support.title: A little help for your workshop.
support.intro: Find a quick answer, or get in touch with AppTunes Labs about Soap Studio.

sections.title: Start with a recipe
sections.text: Choose Recipes → New recipe. Enter an oils weight, add oils and bring their percentages to 100%. Choose your process, superfat, NaOH purity and water method. Check your supplier’s ingredient information before making. Melt-and-pour recipes use a prepared base and do not calculate added NaOH.

sections.title: Plan, weigh, then follow your batch
sections.text: Open a saved recipe and plan a batch. The batch keeps the exact recipe version and ingredient data used at that time. In make mode, check off weighed materials and record what you actually used. Unmolding and curing dates are reminders to inspect your soap; they do not certify that it is ready or safe.

sections.title: Free and lifetime Pro
sections.text: Free includes unlimited recipes, calculation, batch history, make mode, manual cost estimates and portable backups. Pro adds connected material inventory and purchase lots, historical purchase costing, aggregate shopping needs, saved pricing, finished-stock movements and branded reports. The native store purchase screen shows the current price. Pro is a one-time purchase with no recurring subscription.

sections.title: Restore Pro on another device
sections.text: Use the same Apple App Store or Google Play account that made the purchase, connect to the internet, then open Settings → Restore purchases. A workshop backup does not transfer purchase ownership. Apple purchases and Google purchases are separate; cross-store ownership transfer is not currently supported. A pending payment unlocks Pro only after the store confirms it.

sections.title: Keep a copy of your work
sections.text: Open Settings → Save a full backup and choose a location you control. Keep the file somewhere outside the phone before changing devices or uninstalling. Full backups include recipes, batches, purchases and attached photos. Restore validates the file before replacing local workshop data and keeps a safety copy. CSV/JSON import instead adds reviewed records without replacing existing recipes. Never import an unreviewed formula.

sections.title: What works offline?
sections.text: Recipes, calculation, batches, inventory, costing and local files work without an application server or account. Buying or restoring Pro and downloading the purchase screen require internet access. An already verified Pro purchase is cached by the purchase SDK. There is no automatic workshop sync between devices.

sections.title: Reminders and language
sections.text: Enable Workshop reminders in Settings and allow notifications when the system asks. Device notification settings, battery management and time-zone changes can affect delivery; reminders are approximate. The app starts in your device language and falls back to English. Choose another language or the device default in Settings → Language.

sections.title: Contact support
sections.text: Email apptuneslabs@gmail.com. Include Soap Studio, your device, OS version, app version and the steps that caused the problem. For a purchase issue, include the store and approximate purchase date. Do not send payment-card details, passwords or a full workshop backup unless it is needed and you choose to share it. There is no support chat or account sign-in inside the app.

privacy.title: Your workshop stays yours.
privacy.intro: Soap Studio privacy notice. AppTunes Labs / Malkiel Shaul provides Soap Studio. Contact: apptuneslabs@gmail.com. Updated 30 October 2026.

sections.title: Workshop data on your device
sections.text: Recipes, ingredient records, purchases, batch history, prices, notes, workshop name and attached photos are stored in the app’s local storage. Soap Studio does not send this workshop content to AppTunes Labs or RevenueCat. No workshop account is required, and there is no automatic application-server sync. We do not run advertising, third-party advertising tracking or a general-purpose behavioral analytics SDK in the app.

sections.title: Purchases and RevenueCat
sections.text: Apple or Google processes payments. We do not receive payment-card details. Soap Studio uses RevenueCat to display its purchase screen, validate purchases, restore ownership and provide purchase-related reporting. The SDK can contact RevenueCat during app startup and purchase-related use, even if you do not buy Pro. RevenueCat processes a random app user identifier, receipts or purchase tokens, transaction and entitlement information, and technical context such as app/OS version, platform, locale and currency. Purchase-screen interactions may also be processed for purchase analytics. We do not supply your name, email address, recipes, photos or advertising identifier to RevenueCat. Automatic device-identifier collection is disabled in our SDK configuration. Network providers necessarily process connection information when delivering these services. See RevenueCat’s privacy policy for its processing and retention.

sections.title: Files, photos and system services
sections.text: You choose files through system pickers and choose where to save or share exports and backups. Other apps or cloud storage providers you select receive the files you share with them under their own policies. Your operating system may include app data in its device backups according to your settings. Notification permission is requested only when you enable local reminders. Reminders are scheduled on the device. Photo access uses the platform picker; we do not upload your photo library.

sections.title: Support messages
sections.text: If you email support, we receive the address, message and attachments you choose to send. We use them to respond and investigate the issue, and keep them only as needed for support, dispute handling or legal requirements. Avoid sending unnecessary personal information. We do not sell workshop data or support messages.

sections.title: Retention and your choices
sections.text: Local workshop data stays until you delete it, replace it through restore, or remove the app. Exported files, safety copies and operating-system backups must be managed separately in their storage locations. Purchase records are held by the platform store and RevenueCat to validate and restore ownership, prevent fraud, handle refunds and satisfy applicable retention obligations. Removing the app does not erase those purchase records. You can contact us about access, correction or deletion requests; we may need enough information to identify the relevant purchase or support record. Store transaction records and legally required records may need to be retained.

sections.title: Security and international processing
sections.text: The app uses platform storage protections and encrypted network connections for purchase services. You control exported backup files and should store them securely. RevenueCat, Apple, Google and your selected support or storage providers may process information in countries other than yours under their respective safeguards and privacy notices. No storage or transmission system is guaranteed to be risk-free.

sections.title: Children and changes
sections.text: Soap Studio is a workshop tool for soapmakers and is not designed or marketed specifically for children. We do not knowingly request children’s personal information. Contact us if you believe such information was provided. We may update this notice when the app or its processing changes; the date above identifies this version.

terms.title: Soap Studio terms of use.
terms.intro: These terms describe the use of Soap Studio from AppTunes Labs / Malkiel Shaul. Contact: apptuneslabs@gmail.com. Updated 30 October 2026.

sections.title: A workshop tool
sections.text: Soap Studio helps you calculate and organize soapmaking records. Calculations depend on your inputs, ingredient reference values, units and supplier information. Reference values can vary by supplier and lot. The app does not test ingredients or finished soap and does not certify safety, regulatory compliance, labeling or suitability for sale. Follow appropriate training, protective measures and supplier instructions when handling caustic materials. You are responsible for checking your formula and finished product; a curing reminder is not a safety test.

sections.title: Your data and backups
sections.text: You retain your rights in your recipes, photos and other workshop content. Keep independent backups, particularly before replacing a device, restoring data or uninstalling. Workshop content is local and does not automatically sync. Imports must be reviewed; the app cannot verify the chemical accuracy of a source file. Store only content you are entitled to use.

sections.title: Free tools and lifetime Pro
sections.text: The app includes free tools and an optional permanent, non-consumable Pro purchase. The store purchase screen identifies the product and current localized price before you confirm. Lifetime Pro has no recurring subscription charge and unlocks the Pro functionality of Soap Studio while the purchase remains valid. It does not promise support for every future operating system, unrelated future products or cross-store ownership. Apple and Google purchases are separate. Purchases, pending payments, refunds and restoration are governed by the applicable store’s rules and your statutory rights. A refunded or revoked purchase may lose Pro access. Buying or restoring requires an internet connection.

sections.title: Permitted use
sections.text: Use the app lawfully. Do not misrepresent app calculations as laboratory certification, interfere with purchase validation or infringe other people’s rights. Third-party software and fonts remain subject to their licenses, available in Settings → Open-source licenses.

sections.title: Availability and consumer rights
sections.text: We work to keep the app useful and accurate, but errors, device failures and operating-system changes can occur. The app is provided as available to the extent permitted by law. These terms do not exclude rights, remedies, guarantees or liabilities that applicable consumer law does not allow to be excluded. For a problem with the app, contact support; for a refund, use the relevant store’s refund process.
